gloss: to value; to cherish; to take good care of; to treasure

definitions.gloss: to cherish; to treasure; to value
definitions.explanation: To regard someone or something as precious and treat them accordingly. Used for relationships, memories, feelings, and abstract values.

definitions.gloss: to take good care of; to handle carefully
definitions.explanation: To treat a physical object or one's own health with care so as not to damage or lose it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{大切|たいせつ}にする。
⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にしたい。
examples.english: I want to treasure my time with friends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にし⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{尊重|そんちょう}する→尊重する：17456_sonchousuru⟧べきだ。
examples.english: You should respect the other person's opinion while also valuing your own feelings.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にして⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: Please take good care of this book.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にして⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take care of your health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦{指輪|ゆびわ}→指輪：01744_yubiwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I treasure the ring I received from my grandmother.

notes:
One of the most common and versatile expressions in Japanese. お⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or お⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にして⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧ is a standard parting phrase meaning "take care of yourself" — used when saying goodbye, especially when someone is unwell or in difficult circumstances.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{大切|たいせつ}にする: to value people
- ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{大切|たいせつ}にする: to value life
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{大切|たいせつ}にする: to value time
- ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{大切|たいせつ}にする: to take good care of things
- お⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: take care of yourself

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take care of; to treasure — very similar and largely interchangeable; slightly more casual
- ⟦{尊重|そんちょう}する→尊重する：17456_sonchousuru⟧: to respect — more formal; focuses on recognizing value or rights
- ⟦{愛|あい}する→愛する：01811_aisuru⟧: to love — deeper emotional attachment; {大切|たいせつ}にする is broader and includes care without romantic love
